_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Offsetting clusters (bearish ETF/skew/netflow vs bullish CVD/liquidity) and 7-day base rate make HOLD the honest coil call until a score breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Agree on current Anxiety; only analyst specifies next=Complacency/HOLD — narrative silent on forward path
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~45-55 and 30d BTC stays near flat while ETF flows and skew do not trend harder bearish
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with skew normalizing and momentum up (toward Disbelief), or F&G breaks under ~40 with netflow/skew still pinned (deeper Anxiety)
